hooks.name: archivist-intake
hooks.description: Starts the Archivist when the agent creates a .sol file in aegis-forge/input/. PostFileCreate runs in the IDE and CLI V3 only; on Web and for files dropped manually, the Crew schedule in .kiro/crew.yaml covers intake.

action.prompt: A legacy Solidity file was added to aegis-forge/input/. Delegate to the `aegis-archivist` custom agent as a subagent and have it ingest the new file per Requirement 3 in .kiro/specs/aegis-protocol/requirements.md. When it finishes, delegate to `aegis-verifier` to run the PBT suite.
